blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal kitab ki Example 27 hi hai, lafz ba lafz; yeh divisibility ka saboot hai.
15 divisor 14 se 1 zyada hai aur 13 us se 1 kam.
Rule kaunsa? Binomial theorem dono powers par: \((14 + 1)^{13}\) aur \((14 - 1)^{15}\).
Plan: dono expansions mein aakhri terms \(+1\) aur \(-1\) aate hain jo jama karne par cancel ho jate hain; baqi sab mein 14 hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((15)^{13} + (13)^{15}\).
Saabit karna hai: yeh 14 se divisible hai.
Tareeqa: \(15 = 14 + 1\) aur \(13 = 14 - 1\) likhenge. Har binomial expansion mein aakhri term ke ilawa sab terms mein 14 ka factor hota hai. Aakhri terms \(1^{13} = 1\) aur \((-1)^{15} = -1\) hain, jo mil kar zero ho jate hain.

Bases ko nayi shakal dein
\[(15)^{13} + (13)^{15}\]
\[= (14 + 1)^{13} + (14 - 1)^{15}\]
Kyun: Dono bases divisor 14 ke bilkul saath hain, ek upar aur ek neeche. Aisi soorat mein binomial theorem sab se zyada kaam aata hai.

Pehli power expand karein
\[(14 + 1)^{13} = 14^{13} + {}^{13}C_1\,14^{12}\]
\[+ \dots + {}^{13}C_{12}\,14 + 1\]
\[= 14A + 1\]
Kyun: Aakhri term ke ilawa har term mein kam az kam ek 14 hai, to un sab ka jama 14 ka multiple hai; usay \(14A\) kaha, jahan \(A\) koi integer hai.

Doosri power expand karein
\[(14 - 1)^{15} = 14^{15} - {}^{15}C_1\,14^{14}\]
\[+ \dots + {}^{15}C_{14}\,14 - 1\]
\[= 14B - 1\]
Kyun: \(x = -1\) hai, is liye signs baari baari badalte hain. Aakhri term \((-1)^{15} = -1\) hai kyunke 15 odd hai. Baqi sab terms ka jama \(14B\) hai.
Dhyan dein: Agar power even hoti to aakhri term \(+1\) hota aur cancel na hota; is sawal ki jaan yehi odd power hai.

Jama karein
\[(15)^{13} + (13)^{15} = 14A + 1 + 14B - 1\]
\[= 14(A + B)\]
Kyun: \(+1\) aur \(-1\) cancel ho gaye aur jo bacha us mein 14 common hai. \(A + B\) integer hai, is liye poora number 14 ka multiple hai.

Tasdeeq
\[15 + 13^3 = 15 + 2197 = 2212\]
\[2212 = 14 \times 158\]
Kyun: Bari powers ko seedha check karna mushkil hai, is liye isi shakal ka chhota case liya (15 ki koi power, 13 ki odd power). Woh bhi 14 se poora divide hua, jaise humare saboot ne bataya.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \((15)^{13} + (13)^{15} = 14(A + B)\), jo 14 se divisible hai.
